svg.text: Price / value display + reported-savings label (never a guarantee)
Reported savings compare the voucher value set by the merchant with the price you pay.
What you save overall depends on what you buy.
Valid for 30 days after you buy it
QR and codes never mirror (LTR island). Western digits in
MVP does NOT show: gifting, promo codes, loyalty-point
payment, partial redemption, saved cards, quantity stepper.
Voucher is created only after a CONFIRMED payment.
